folders.description: Active efforts with a goal and an end date.
folders.conventions: One note per project; link the notes that feed it. Move it to Archive/ when it ends.
folders.examples: Launch the newsletter; Plan the Lisbon trip.
folders.anti_examples: Ongoing responsibilities with no end date (they go in Areas/).

folders.description: Ongoing responsibilities with no end date, such as health or finances.
folders.conventions: One subfolder per area; notes describe the standard to maintain, not a task list.
folders.anti_examples: A single effort with a deadline (it goes in Projects/).

folders.description: Concepts, entities and references reused across projects.
folders.conventions: Atomic notes with one idea each; the file name is the concept.
Move notes here instead of deleting them.
